subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Assam.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Dispur. Assam covers a geographic area of 78,438 sq km across 35 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Brahmaputra, Barak, Manas, Subansiri.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: World-famous for Assam tea, Muga golden silk, petroleum (Digboi is Asia's oldest refinery), and Kaziranga National Park, the sanctuary of the Great Indian One-Horned Rhinoceros.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Assam.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Assam was formally instituted on 26 January 1950. Official language(s): Assamese, Bodo, Bengali.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Sattriya (Classical Dance), Bihu, Bagurumba.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Bihu (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali), Ambubachi Mela.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Assam.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Lakshman Prasad Acharya.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Assam is Himanta Biswa Sarma.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Gauhati High Court (Guwahati).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: One-horned rhinoceros | State Bird: White-winged duck | State Flower: Foxtail orchid (Kopou phool) | State Tree: Hollong.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Assam.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Petroleum (Digboi, Naharkatiya), Natural Gas, Coal, Limestone.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Assam plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Assam.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Kamakhya Temple, Rang Ghar, Kareng Ghar, Talatal Ghar.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Kaziranga, Manas, Dibru-Saikhowa, Nameri, Orang, Raimona, Dehing Patkai.

subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Assam.

facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Orunodoi 3.0, Pragyan Bharati, Nijut Moina Scheme.
